notes.title: CLAIRE - Official Release Date Trailer Premiere!
notes.notes:
🎬 [b]Watch the Official Release Date Trailer for Claire![/b]

The wait is almost over. Claire, the spiritual sequel to [b]Ethel[/b], is nearly here, and it's scarier, deeper, and more intense than ever.

In this new trailer, get a glimpse of the atmosphere, puzzles, and horrors that await you in Claire. From improved lighting and AI to new gameplay mechanics and terrifying sound design, this is the most immersive experience I’ve created yet!

🗓️ [b]Release Date Reveal[/b] – Find out when Claire launches.

🎮 Wishlist Claire now to be notified at launch: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3233130/Claire/

📺 Watch the trailer: https://youtu.be/g9M_HCMUiYc

Let me know what you think in the comments, and thank you for all the support!

notes.title: Claire Release Date Trailer Drops May 17th!!!
notes.notes:
[b]Claire – Release Date Trailer Launches May 17th[/b]



It’s almost time. Claire’s Release Date Trailer drops on May 17th, and you won’t want to miss it.



This intense horror experience follows the story left behind in Ethel and brings new gameplay mechanics, scares, and story depth. The trailer will reveal when Claire officially launches, along with fresh footage to give you a taste of what’s coming.



[b]Set your calendars. Get ready. Claire is almost here.[/b]

notes.title: Game Changing Update is HERE!
notes.notes:
[i]What's in the Update?[/i]

- Checkpoint save feature added

- Increased number of scares 

- Multi-language support integrated

- Reduced reading in notes by 50%

- Improved optimization for smoother gameplay

- Enhanced visuals for a more immersive experience

- Upgraded lighting for better atmosphere

- Objective prompts implemented

- Adjusted locations of certain progression items for smoother gameplay flow

- Added an Inverted Mouse option

- Added a V-Sync option

- Reworked the “Bad Ending” for improved narrative

- Player can now "run" when outdoors



### Bug Fixes & Patches :

- Resolved issue where player could get stuck underneath stairs

- Adjusted background opacity to make white lettering in notes easier to read

notes.title: HOLD ON! Major Update Coming Soon—Wishlist Now for the Best Experience
notes.notes:
[i]Dear Players[/i],

Before you hit that "[b]Buy[/b]" button,  I wanted to share some exciting news! A [b]major update[/b] is on the horizon, set to dramatically enhance your gameplay experience. I'm talking about:


[list]

[*] [b]Checkpoint Save Feature[/b]: ✔ Need to take a break from soiling your pants? Reach one of two checkpoints and return when you've come back with fresh pants.

[*] [b]Better Lighting[/b]: 🌟 Atmosphere matters, and the new lighting will immerse you like never before.

[*] [b]Clearer Objectives[/b]: ⏳ No need to sit and finish the game in one session, reach a checkpoint and come back to it later.

[*] [b]Clearer Objectives[/b]: 🧭 No more wandering—get to your next goal with ease.

[*] [b]Better Optimization[/b]: 🚀 Smoother gameplay.

[*] [b]More Scares[/b]: 👻 Prepare for an even creepier experience.
 
[*] [b]Multiple Languages[/b]: 🌍 Enjoy the game in your preferred language.

[*] [b]Less Reading, More Action[/b]: 📖✂️ I've cut the reading by 50%—now the story unfolds more naturally.

[*] Plus, a new trailer and updated screenshots will be added soon to give you a sneak peek at what's coming! 🎥📸
[/list]

I recommend adding the game to your [b]Wishlist[/b] now and [i]waiting for this update[/i] to drop in just a few days. This way, you'll dive into the best version of the game from the start.


Thank you for your support, and stay tuned for more updates!

[i]TS Games LLC[/i]

notes.title: Minor Bug Fixes and Changes to Lighting
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug that caused player dialogue to remain on screen for a long period of time after interacting with certain items. 

- Fixed the lighting making it easier for players to navigate and see.

notes.title: How to Update Ethel
notes.notes: Although the updates are functioning correctly, they are not being applied [b]UNTIL[/b] the player logs out of their Steam account and then logs back in. The update will then commence.
